detail.title: GW185 Universal 270° Racing Wheel with Shifter & Pedals
detail.overview: The Ant Esports GW185 is a USB-powered racing wheel with a 270-degree rotation range and an ergonomically simulated design, built to bring realistic drag-racing feel to PC, Xbox One, PS3, PS4, Nintendo Switch and Android TV. Built-in dual vibration motors sync haptic feedback to in-game action, while linear pedals give precise, progressive throttle control and racing-style paddle shifters plus a sequential shifter add authentic gear-changing feel. Sensitivity can be switched across three stages to match your preferred play style, and programmable buttons let you set up quick shortcuts for faster in-game access. A well-rounded, wired racing wheel for casual and semi-serious sim racers alike.
